top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes the full mechanism-to-medicine arc of GLP-1: Holst's demonstration of its glucose-dependent incretin action, Mojsov's identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) form, and Drucker's receptor and gut-hormone biology with the therapeutic concept. It is original, independently confirmed over decades, and mature, with randomized outcome trials showing benefit in glycaemia, weight, and cardiovascular and renal endpoints. The three-laureate allocation fits the prize limit and the citation scope (physiology and active form of GLP-1, enabling incretin-based treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity) is accurate and bounded. No award would withhold recognition from clearly Nobel-worthy, mature work.
